svg.title: The prescribed support and derivative bounds thus give CT v per representative, and counting the enlarged support gives CT v−4. The recorded boundary and high-frequency alternatives supply the same bound for the periodic symbol when a representative changes. This transports the finite difference of the actual symbol rather than replacing it by a continuum derivative. Let Fx(f) = P p χp(x)f(p) be the finite Fourier reader. Index translation is a bijection of the same torus, so Fx(∆v −eνf) = (χeν(x) −1)vFx(f)
